assets.name: switch-character
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit image 1, an existing app button. Image 2 is the friend-list button: use its scalloped fabric/lace badge silhouette and dashed pink stitching as border reference. User wants MUCH lighter pastel colors and no heavy rings. Replace image 1's thick concentric gold/brown biscuit rings completely with a delicate ivory scalloped doily/lace border, fine pale peach edge and a single fine dashed blush pink stitched line like image 2. No thick concentric rings, no metallic rim, no dark orange outlines, no heavy shadows. Keep the central subject recognizable and comfortably inside the stitching. Change the central cat head to a WHITE cat with pale pink inner ears, tiny gentle face and blush. Preserve the two switching arrows but make them soft pastel blush pink. Palette airy milky ivory, powder pink, light peach, soft butter yellow; thin warm pale tan outlines with enough contrast to read at 72px. Match friend's cute hand-painted 2D art. Single centered front-facing button on genuinely transparent alpha background, square image, entire scalloped badge occupies 94% of canvas dimensions with even transparent margin. No text outside button, no extra objects, no checkerboard baked in, no notification dots.
